segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the order form and make sure we’re clean for the March 18 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’ve got 42 seats to start, with the option to add the support team in Q3. Finance just needs the invoice split quarterly, not annual upfront.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I have 42 named users, $38,640 annual subscription, billed $9,660 per quarter. Net 30. The billing tool should generate the first invoice on April 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One thing I noticed in the onboarding packet, it says data migration is 90 days of records. We had planned on bringing over everything back to January 2023.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, yeah, I see what you mean. Let me clean that up before the kickoff. The scope should reflect January 2023 forward, not just the default 90 days.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good, because ops is already pulling that export and it’s about 18,000 rows.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s fine. If it’s under 25,000 records, there’s no extra services fee. We’ll just need the file by March 7 so the team can validate fields.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Works. For single sign-on, our IT lead is Marcus. He’s out next Friday but available the week of the 10th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll put Marcus on the technical checklist and send the calendar hold for March 11 at 1 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send me the revised packet and I’ll route it to procurement today.
